app.title: Life Path / Ubuzima
app.subtitle: NISR CRVS 2025
intro.title: Uri umwe mu banyarwanda 14,108,217
intro.subtitle: Hitamo umwirondoro wawe utangirireho urugendo rw'ubuzima muri 2025.
intro.caption: Muri 2025 abaturage b'u Rwanda bageze kuri miliyoni 14.1. Hejuru ya 50% bafite munsi y'imyaka 25.
birth.title: 1 muri 356,838
birth.subtitle: Kanda winjire mu muryango w'impinja zose zanditswe muri 2025.
birth.sex_ratio: Igipimo cy'ivuka: Abahungu 102.7 kuri buri bakobwa 100.
birth.tfr_statement: Abagore bo mu Rwanda babyara abana bagera kuri 3.5 muri rusange.
birth.completeness: Iyandikwa ry'amavuko mu Rwanda ryageze kuri 92.9% muri 2025.
birth.caption: Muri 2025, impinja 356,838 zanditswe mu bitabo by'irangamimerere mu Rwanda (abahungu 180,795 n'abakobwa 176,043).
birth.tap_to_be_born: __TODO__ Tap anywhere or press Space to be born

growing.title: Gukurira mu misozi igihumbi
growing.subtitle: Urugendo rwo gukura kuva mu bwana kugera mu bukure.
growing.caption: Ikiragano gishya gifite amahirwe yo kwiga no kwitabwaho n'abajyanama b'ubuzima.
marriage.title: Urugendo rwo gushyingirwa
marriage.instruction: Kurura impeta ugaragaze imyaka utekereza washyingiriweho, urebe aho uhurira n'ukuri.
marriage.caption: Gushyingirwa 50,256 byanditswe muri 2025 (igipimo cya 3.6 kuri buri baturage 1,000).
divorce.title: Gusesa ishyingirwa
divorce.instruction: Keka igihe ishyingirwa ryarambye mbere yo gutandukana, hanyuma urebe ukuri.
divorce.peak_duration: Gutandukana byibanda hagati y'imyaka 5–9 yo gushyingirwa (1,076), bigakurikirwa n'imyaka 10–14 (928).
divorce.avg_age_men: Impuzandengo y'imyaka yo gutandukana: 43.3 ku bagabo.
divorce.avg_age_women: Impuzandengo y'imyaka yo gutandukana: 39.8 ku bagore.
divorce.caption: Gusesa ishyingirwa 4,479 byanditswe muri 2025 (igipimo cya 0.2 kuri 1,000).
death.title: Umusozo w'ubuzima
death.instruction: Shakashaka imiterere y'impfu n'impamvu z'ingenzi zizitera.
death.u_shape: Impfu 6,393 zagaragaye munsi y'imyaka 5, zikagabanuka mu busore zikongera kwiyongera mu busaza.
death.facility_top: Ku isonga mu mavuriro: Indwara zibasira impinja nshya (14.9%).
death.community_top: Ku isonga mu miryango: Indwara z'umutima zidasobanutse (16.2%) n'indwara zikomeye z'umutima (11.1%).
death.caption: Impfu 39,355 zanditswe muri 2025 (22,051 z'abagabo, 17,304 z'abagore). Igipimo: Abagabo 127.4 kuri buri bagore 100.
outro.title: Urugendo rurashojwe
outro.subtitle: Murakoze gukurikirana imibare y'irangamimerere y'u Rwanda muri 2025.
outro.nisr_citation: Imibare yose ikomoka muri raporo ya NISR (CRVS 2025 Annual Report).
caveat.composite_life: Uru rugendo rwubakiye ku ishusho rusange y'imibare ya 2025 n'icyerekezo cya 2019–2025.
caveat.registered_not_occurring: Imibare igaragaza amavuko yanditswe mu buyobozi muri 2025 (kuri 92.9% by'ibiteganyijwe).
caveat.marriage_registration: Imibare igaragaza ishyingirwa ryanditswe mu buyobozi (Table 18 ya raporo ya NISR).
caveat.divorce_not_rate: Ubutane bwanditswe muri 2025 ntibusobanura igipimo cy'abashyingiranywe batandukana, kuko 41.3% baciwe mu nkiko mbere ya 2025.
caveat.registered_deaths_completeness: Impfu 39,355 zanditswe zingana na 50.5% by'impfu ziteganyijwe. Yitwa gusa impfu zanditswe.
pyramid.aria_label: Igishushanyo cy'imiterere y'abaturage b'u Rwanda muri 2025 hakurikijwe imyaka n'igitsina
pyramid.table_caption: Imbonerahamwe y'abaturage b'u Rwanda muri 2025 hakurikijwe imyaka n'igitsina
